name: Manila
description: The capital and gateway to the country. Walk the Spanish-era walls of Intramuros, dig into Filipino food halls, and use it as a jumping-off point for the rest of Luzon.

name: Baguio
description: A pine-covered mountain city in the Cordilleras, known for cool weather, night markets, and easy access to rice-terrace day trips.

name: Cebu
description: The Visayas' main hub — a mix of colonial-era landmarks, a lively food scene, and quick boat access to nearby islands like Bantayan and Malapascua.

name: Bohol
description: Home to the Chocolate Hills and tarsier sanctuaries, plus the white-sand beaches of Panglao Island for diving and relaxing.

name: Boracay
description: One of the country's most famous beach destinations — powder-white sand along White Beach, watersports, and a lively strip of bars and restaurants.

name: Siargao
description: The country's surfing capital, famous for Cloud 9's reef break, island-hopping to Naked and Guyam islands, and a laid-back, palm-lined pace of life.

name: Davao
description: Mindanao's largest city, at the foot of Mt. Apo. A calm, orderly base for durian markets, eagle sanctuaries, and trips into the surrounding highlands.

name: Palawan (El Nido)
bestTimeToVisit: December – May (dry season, best lagoon visibility)
description: Limestone cliffs, hidden lagoons, and island-hopping tours around El Nido and Coron. Widely considered one of the most scenic destinations in the country.
